youtube.title: The Philadelphia Experiment: Did the Navy Really Make a Ship Vanish? (Full Case File)
youtube.description:
In October 1943, the legend says, the US Navy made the destroyer escort USS Eldridge invisible at the Philadelphia Navy Yard and teleported it to Norfolk, Virginia. This documentary follows the paper trail back to where the story really began: letters written in 1956 by Carl Meredith Allen (signing as "Carlos Miguel Allende") to UFO author Morris K. Jessup, an annotated book sent to the Office of Naval Research, and the 127-copy "Varo edition." Then it checks the legend against the Navy's records: the Eldridge's war diary, the movement records of Allen's ship, the SS Andrew Furuseth, and the Navy and ONR's own statements. And it explains what was probably real: degaussing, which made ships "invisible" only to magnetic mines.
